_readme: Knowledge base for the STAA Assistant (assets/js/assistant.js) and the optional AI worker (ai-assistant/). Each FAQ needs: id, q (the question as a visitor would ask it), keywords (words or short phrases that point to it, lowercase), a (the answer). Optional: link {href, label}, handoff (true = also offer WhatsApp). Only include facts you are happy for the assistant to repeat.
suggestions: Can you represent us before TRA?
How much do your services cost?

faqs.q: What services do you offer?
faqs.a: STAA has five practice areas: (1) tax advisory and compliance, (2) accounting and financial management, (3) business advisory, (4) audit support and risk advisory, and (5) East Africa market support. Ask me about any of them, or see the full list on our services page.

faqs.q: Can STAA represent us before the Tanzania Revenue Authority?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide tax audit support and representation before the Tanzania Revenue Authority (TRA), alongside preparing and filing corporate, individual, VAT and PAYE returns.

faqs.q: Can you prepare and file our tax returns?
faqs.a: Yes. We prepare and file corporate, individual, VAT and PAYE returns, and run compliance reviews so you meet every TRA deadline.

faqs.q: Do you help with tax planning?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide tax planning and strategy aligned with Tanzanian and East African tax laws, including advice on cross-border taxation within East African markets. For advice on your specific situation, an advisor will need to review your details.

faqs.q: What is the tax rate, penalty or rule for my situation?
faqs.a: Tax rates, thresholds and penalties change with each Finance Act and depend on your circumstances, so I don’t quote figures here. An STAA advisor can confirm what applies to you.

faqs.q: What is the tax health check?
faqs.a: The tax health check is a free, 1-minute quiz on our home page. Five yes-or-no questions show where your business may have compliance gaps, and it suggests which STAA service can help.

faqs.q: Do you offer bookkeeping and accounting?
faqs.a: Yes. Our accounting and financial management service covers bookkeeping and record management, IFRS financial statements, payroll and statutory compliance, financial reporting and performance analysis, and budgeting and cash-flow management.

faqs.q: Can you prepare IFRS financial statements?
faqs.a: Yes. We prepare financial statements in line with IFRS standards, ready to share with lenders, donors and investors. We also support the bookkeeping, payroll, reporting and budgeting behind them.

faqs.q: Do you manage payroll?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle payroll management and statutory compliance as part of our accounting and financial management service.

faqs.q: Can you help with budgeting and cash flow?
faqs.a: Yes. We help with budgeting and cash-flow management, and with financial reporting and performance analysis so you can see how the business is really doing.

faqs.q: Can you help me register or structure a business?
faqs.a: Yes. We help with business registration and structuring in Tanzania and across East Africa, and we support startups and SMEs as they scale.

faqs.q: Do you prepare business plans or feasibility studies?
faqs.a: Yes. Our business advisory team prepares feasibility studies and business plans, builds financial models, and gives investment advice.

faqs.q: Do you help with corporate governance and internal controls?
faqs.a: Yes. We design corporate governance and internal control systems, and our risk advisory team reviews existing controls for weak points.

faqs.q: Do you offer audit support and risk advisory?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide internal audit support, risk assessment and management frameworks, compliance audits and operational reviews, and advice on fraud prevention and financial controls.

faqs.q: Do you work with businesses outside Tanzania?
faqs.a: Yes. We advise on doing business within the East African Community (EAC), including cross-border business setup, tax considerations, regulatory compliance across regional jurisdictions, and trade and investment advice.

faqs.q: Who do you work with? Do you only work with large companies?
faqs.a: We work with clients of every size: SMEs, startups and entrepreneurs, corporates, NGOs and development partners, government and public-sector entities, and individual professionals.

faqs.q: Do you work with NGOs and donor-funded projects?
faqs.a: Yes. NGOs and development partners are among our core clients. We prepare IFRS financial statements and reports that meet donor expectations, and support internal controls and audit readiness.

faqs.q: Will our financial information be kept confidential?
faqs.a: Yes. Client confidentiality is one of the four principles behind every STAA engagement, together with accuracy, timely delivery and tailored solutions. Our privacy policy explains how we handle personal data.

faqs.q: Who is STAA?
faqs.a: Smile Tax & Accounting Advisory (STAA) is a professional financial services firm based in Dar es Salaam. We provide tax, accounting and business advisory services to organisations and individuals across Tanzania and East Africa, helping them achieve compliance, clarity and sustainable growth.

faqs.q: Where is your office?
faqs.a: We're at Goba Centre, Dar es Salaam. Our postal address is P.O. Box 66678, Dar es Salaam. You'll find a map on our contact page.

faqs.q: How can I contact STAA or book a consultation?
faqs.a: Call or WhatsApp us on +255 717 402 578, email info@staa.co.tz, or send an enquiry through our contact page. An advisor will get back to you.

faqs.q: How much do your services cost?
faqs.a: Our fees depend on the scope and complexity of the work, so we quote each engagement individually. Tell an advisor what you need and they'll give you a clear quote.
